اقتعدت (form VIII)

# اِقْتَعَدْتَ (iqtaʕadta) /iq.ta.ʕad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اِقْتَعَدْتِ (iqtaʕadti) /iq.ta.ʕad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اِقْتَعَدَتْ (iqtaʕadat) /iq.ta.ʕa.dat/: third-perso
